checks.name: complete_capture_set
checks.detail: Real screenshots=36, expected36

scope: Independent survival world; normal production mayfly grant, logical double-space entry and W motion. F5 uses vanilla KeyMapping.click/consumeClick. No forced camera position, remote avatar, forced shader route or pre-enabled ordinary flight. Pixel candidate is a diagnostic proxy backed by saved actual screenshots, not a draw-count success claim. No native GLFW physical-key certification.
glStageScope: AFTER_PARTICLES before/after priority brackets the production geometry callback. AFTER_LEVEL and final RenderTick END cover the deferred composites plus normal intervening vanilla rendering; their FBO differences are observations, not automatically a leak. GUI-pre observation runs after higher-priority listeners. GL errors are recorded at each stage.
